## Self-review gate

- [ ] The pull request targets dev, or the release/hotfix target documented in the workflow.
- [ ] I read the complete diff from the base branch.
- [ ] The failure path is covered or explicitly documented.
- [ ] Tests and smoke checks cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and release notes are updated when needed.
- [ ] No secrets, generated binaries, local configuration or personal files are included.
- [ ] License and version metadata remain consistent.
- [ ] The independent end-of-slice review is complete and its findings were considered.
- [ ] I resolved every review conversation and recorded remaining uncertainty.
